stage_2_story.text_en:
On Friday afternoon, Benny decided to cook a special Shabbat dinner for the whole family. He wanted to make his mother's roast chicken recipe, which he had not tried in years.

First, he checked the recipe and made a list of every ingredient he needed. He drove to the supermarket and bought everything: fresh chicken, garlic, lemon, olive oil, and a collection of spices for the seasoning.

Back home, Benny began by chopping the garlic and mixing it with lemon juice, olive oil, paprika, and cumin. He placed the chicken pieces in the marinade and left them to marinate in the fridge for two hours.

When it was time to cook, Benny preheated the oven to 190 degrees. While waiting, he sautéed some onions in a pan until they were soft and golden. Then he placed the marinated chicken in the oven and let it roast for forty-five minutes.

For the soup, he let it simmer on low heat for thirty minutes until it was rich and flavourful. He tasted it carefully and adjusted the seasoning — a little more salt and a pinch of pepper.

When the family sat down to eat, Benny served each person a generous portion and added a small garnish of fresh parsley on top of the soup. Everyone said it was the best Shabbat dinner they had enjoyed in a long time.
